summary.text: Dean VanSchoiack is a Republican state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 9, an office he has held since January 2021, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as broker and says he has worked as a farmer, auctioneer and real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Dean VanSchoiack was born in St. Joseph, Missouri, and lives in Savannah, Missouri.
Ballotpedia says he earned a degree in speech and communication and that his career experience includes working as a farmer, auctioneer and real estate broker.
VanSchoiack assumed office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Sheila Solon, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignment is the Pensions Committee.
